title: The Legend of Heroes II: Prophecy of the Moonlight Witch

info.about: The Legend of Heroes II: Prophecy of the Moonlight Witch, known as The Legend of Heroes III: Shiroki Majo in Japan, is a 1994 role-playing video game developed by Nihon Falcom. It is the third game in The Legend of Heroes series, and the first in the Gagharv trilogy; however, it was retitled to include a "two" in the title for its North American release.
